build_llada2moe_model: build an LLaDA2 MoE model with sparse mixture-of-experts and tensor parallelism for inference
load_llada2moe_weights: load checkpoint weights into an LLaDA2 MoE model with expert parameter sharding and gate projection mapping
create_llada2moe_attention: create a multi-head attention layer with QK normalization, rotary embeddings, and radix KV cache for encoder-only attention
run_llada2moe_forward: run a forward pass through the LLaDA2 MoE model with positions, input IDs, and forward batch info for token generation
get_expert_location_config: get model configuration for expert location dispatch including num layers, logical experts, and expert groups
